title: automation: a packaged flow cannot ship switched off for an administrator to turn on — `status: 'obsolete'` disarms it for good, yet `POST /automation/:name/toggle` answers 200 {enabled:true}
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Found while building hotcrm#2558 (an accepted quote creates an order; "accepted quote drafts a contract" must ship as a packaged flow that is **off** by default and that an administrator can switch **on**). Measured on 18.5.0 by the hotcrm PSA lane; read in code on `main` 3452dec219.

## What happens

1. **There is no way to ship a packaged flow switched off.** The two disable dimensions are the definition's `status` and the activation ledger (`isFlowEnabled`, `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` ~6205: `flowStatusDisabled !== true && !flowLedgerDisabled.has(name)`). A package can only write `status`. With no `sys_metadata_activation` row the flow is enabled, and `status: 'draft'` still fires (`plugin.ts` ~2805 says so). Nothing in the flow schema declares a ledger default.
2. **`status: 'obsolete'` disarms it for good.** `toggleFlow` (`flow-definitions.ts` ~522) writes `active: true` to the ledger and clears `flowLedgerDisabled`, then calls `activateFlowTrigger`. That call declines, because `flowStatusDisabled` still holds the shipped `obsolete`. Measured on a fresh install: the admin toggle on wrote `active:true`, and the flow never ran.
3. **The toggle door reports success anyway.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` ~3965 answers `deps.success({ name, enabled })`, which echoes the request and not the engine state. So the administrator is told the flow is on while it stays off. `GET /automation/_status` would show `enabled:false`.

The rest of the switch works: the toggle off writes the ledger row, and the row survives a restart and an upgrade that changes the flow body (6.5.0 → 6.6.0 scratch).

## Asked

- **A)** A packaged flow can declare that it ships switched off: a ledger default the install honours when there is no row, which an administrator's toggle then overrides. Document it in the automation skill.
- **B)** Toggling a flow on when its status disarms it must refuse with a sentence saying why (the status is the author's), or report `enabled:false`. It must not answer `{enabled:true}`.

## Done when

A package ships a record-change flow off. A fresh install does not fire it. An admin toggle on makes it fire, and that state survives a restart and an upgrade. Toggling a status-disarmed flow no longer reports success.

Blocks: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2558 (the contract-draft switch).
